verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents per-app secrets that are encrypted and stored in a vault. For Sprites, it describes org-wide service connections, scoped access grants by name, label or endpoint, and one-step credential rotation across all Sprites. These amount to central credential management, but only as brief marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: team-member access/RBAC controls, central (org-level) environment variable management, in-depth docs on org-wide secret scoping for regular Fly Apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
